change.description: Add system-shared and durable models.dev provider/model selection memory, exact quote-provider choices, and first-discovery/view state.
change.release_unit_description: System Models page sync-memory API, additive SQLite state, and reviewed price synchronization.

planned.reasoning: The state API and preview fields are additive. New persistent service-owned state is a user-visible capability and uses additive tables without backfilling or rewriting prior model, price, preset, or cost data.

scope_drift.description: Implementation remains within the approved additive API and SQLite sync-memory contract.

current.reasoning: The sync-state endpoint and preview additions preserve existing request behavior. Five additive tables hold only new sync-review preferences and discovery state; existing prices, presets, and invocation costs are not transformed.

verified.reasoning: The additive sync-state API, transactional persistence, restart behavior, and unchanged existing model/pricing state are verified by the scoped compatibility evidence.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing clients may continue using the prior preview and apply contracts; the state route and preview metadata are additive.

persistent_state.state_description: Service-shared model/provider selections, quote-provider choices, catalog baseline metadata, and discovered/viewed model IDs.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Earlier repository versions with managed-model and pricing tables but before the additive sync-memory tables; direct Major skips are not claimed.
